machine.dedicated_or_shared: SHARED — cloud sandbox, not a dedicated benchmarking host
machine.cpu_steal_time_observed: ~40 jiffies steal out of ~293,704 total jiffies at post-run snapshot (~0.01%) — negligible at time of check; not continuously monitored throughout the run

hardware.cpu_governor: not exposed / not controllable in this sandbox

bun.git_commit: N/A — release build, not source-controlled build

deno.install_method: release (downloaded from GitHub Releases during this session — deno.land/install.sh returned HTTP 403)
deno.commit_pin_status: N/A for this experiment — H6 uses the release-comparison track per notes/12-experiment-design.md Section 3; the source-controlled pin gap (Stage 11 open item 27) remains open and is NOT resolved by this run

database_driver.note: Deliberately used identically across Bun, Node, and Deno (Deno via npm:pg@8.13.1 specifier) instead of each runtime's own idiomatic/native client, to remove driver-implementation as a confound axis. This is a documented deviation from a strict reading of 'each runtime's native client' — see results/README.md Confounders section.

background_workload.description: Shared cloud sandbox; no other user workload knowingly running concurrently, but this is a multi-tenant KVM guest and true isolation cannot be guaranteed or verified beyond the steal-time spot check above.
other_processes_running: postgresql (main cluster, idle except during Workload B runs)

database.instance_type: local, native apt-installed cluster (not containerized) — single instance shared by all three runtimes' Workload B servers, run sequentially never concurrently
database.seed_data: 10,000 deterministic rows generated via generate_series (no random() used) — reproducible from schema.sql alone
database.query: SELECT id, name, email, balance_cents FROM accounts WHERE id = $1, parameter fixed at 42 for every request, every run, every runtime
database.connection_pool_per_server: pg.Pool, max: 10, idleTimeoutMillis: 30000 — identical across all three runtimes' Workload B servers

load_generator.machine_placement: same machine as server and database (loopback, 127.0.0.1) — not a separate load-generation host

configuration.note_on_deviation: Stage 12 protocol specified concurrency=50, warmup=30s, timed=60s. Reduced here due to the 2-vCPU shared-sandbox constraint (concurrency) and session wall-clock constraints (durations). See results/README.md.

cache_state.drop_method: N/A — H6 is a steady-state throughput/latency experiment, not a cold-start experiment (that is H3's and H7's concern)

notes: Full raw autocannon JSON output for all 60 runs preserved individually in ../raw/<run_id>.json plus the consolidated ../raw/run_index.json. Benchmark source preserved in ../benchmark/. This metadata.json was filled from values actually observed on the execution machine during this run, not copied from a template unfilled.
